changelog: 🔄 Auto-landscape: video now rotates to fullscreen landscape automatically when playback starts
🔁 Manual rotate button in player controls (portrait ⇄ landscape)
📱 Returns to normal portrait view when you close the player
🎬 Source overhaul: dead SuperStream mirror replaced with VidLink Pro (verified live)
🧠 Nuvio-style RAM-adaptive buffering: right-sized buffers for your exact TV (bigger buffer = fewer rebuffers)
⚡ 40s VOD buffer window + 256KB allocator segments for smoother long playback
🧊 All previous fixes retained: 4s freeze detection, 2-stage recovery, UI drift fix
